2608.06955.title: Critical Acclaim Orientation in Large Language Models: Evidence from Film Preference Elicitation
2608.06955.paper_summary: Large language models (LLMs) are trained on corpora that contain expressions of human judgment about films, books, music, and more. Yet whether LLMs systematically reproduce evaluative hierarchies remains unclear. Prior research on cultural bias in LLMs suggests competing expectations: models may mirror the popularity signals of internet texts, or may reproduce forms of prestige embedded in critical discourse. We probe this question through a study of film evaluations with eight models from four families (Anthropic, OpenAI, Alibaba, and Mistral), using a 200-film benchmark partitioned into critically acclaimed, commercially successful, and dual-legitimacy (critical acclaim + commercial success) films. Across 20,000 pairwise forced-choice comparisons per model analyzed with Bradley--Terry estimation, we observe a consistent critical acclaim orientation with all models: critically acclaimed yet commercially obscure films are selected over commercially successful yet critically unrecognized ones. This pattern grows with model scale within each family. In addition, nested OLS regression analyses show that evaluative orientation, public visibility, and popular reception distinctly help explain preferences. Adjusting for public visibility reverses the models' preference for dual-legitimacy films over critical acclaim-only films, while additionally accounting for popular reception attenuates much of the disadvantage of films with commercial success only. Finally, evaluative and recommendation-oriented prompt framings produce divergent rankings, suggesting that critical acclaim orientation may manifest indirectly in real-world LLM deployments.
2608.06955.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型（LLMs）是在包含人類對電影、書籍、音樂等表達評價的語料庫上訓練的。然而，LLMs 是否系統性地重現評價層級仍不明朗。先前對 LLMs 中文化偏見的研究提出了相互競爭的期待：模型可能反映互聯網文本的流行信號，或者可能重現嵌入在批評話語中的聲望形式。我們通過對四個家族（Anthropic、OpenAI、Alibaba 和 Mistral）的八個模型進行的電影評價研究來探討這一問題，使用了一個包含 200 部電影的基準，這些電影被劃分為獲得批評讚譽、商業成功和雙重合法性（批評讚譽 + 商業成功）電影。在對每個模型進行的 20,000 次成對強制選擇比較中，使用 Bradley--Terry 估計，我們觀察到所有模型都有一致的批評讚譽取向：獲得批評讚譽但商業上不知名的電影被選擇，而商業上成功但未獲得批評認可的電影則被排除。這一模式在每個家族內隨著模型規模的增長而增強。此外，嵌套的 OLS 回歸分析顯示，評價取向、公共能見度和流行接受度明顯有助於解釋偏好。調整公共能見度會逆轉模型對雙重合法性電影相對於僅有批評讚譽電影的偏好，而進一步考慮流行接受度則減弱了僅有商業成功電影的劣勢。最後，評價和推薦導向的提示框架產生了不同的排名，這表明批評讚譽取向可能在現實世界的 LLM 部署中間接體現。
